fixes.title: Encrypt this PC's hard drive with BitLocker
fixes.why: If the PC is lost or stolen, encryption stops anyone reading your business files.
steps: Click Start, type BitLocker and open Manage BitLocker.
Next to the C: drive, click Turn on BitLocker.
Save the recovery key to your Microsoft account or print it, and keep it somewhere safe.
Choose to encrypt the used disk space only, then Start encrypting.
Keep the PC switched on and plugged in until it finishes.

fixes.title: Switch on Defender's anti-ransomware rules
fixes.why: These rules block common tricks ransomware uses, such as harmful email attachments.
steps: Ask your IT helper to turn on Microsoft Defender's Attack Surface Reduction rules.
Ask for the ransomware-related rules to be set to Block.
Use the PC as normal for a day and report anything that stops working.
